payload.tension: The passage states the cross overturns wisdom and boasting. For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God. that, as it is written, “He who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.” It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
